name: RDP Activity
description: Inbound and outbound Remote Desktop: network connection, authentication, session logon, reconnect, disconnect and logoff on the target; connection attempts from the client (RDPClient); RD Gateway. Security 4624/4625 are not included because they cover every logon type; use Logon/Logoff Activity with the Logon type column (10 = RemoteInteractive).
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)
